name: Asana MCP
description: Lets agents search, create, and update Asana tasks, projects, and portfolios over a hosted OAuth MCP server, and post project status updates.

skills.name: Task Search
skills.description: Searches tasks by text and filters such as assignee, due date, project, tag, and custom fields, or lists your own tasks.

skills.name: Bulk Task Changes
skills.description: Creates or updates up to 50 tasks per call, including assignees, due dates, dependencies, and subtasks.

skills.name: Project Setup
skills.description: Creates a project with sections and tasks in one operation, or drafts it as a preview for review in Claude or ChatGPT.

skills.name: Status Reporting
skills.description: Builds aggregated status overviews for projects or portfolios and posts colored status updates to them.
